name: Herkimer Diamond
physical: Crystal healers link it to easing tension
Many people keep it nearby for a feeling of balance and ease
summary: Herkimer Diamond is a naturally double-terminated quartz from New York, a brilliant, clear stone of amplification, dreams and spiritual attunement in crystal lore.
intro: Herkimer diamonds are not diamonds at all but exceptionally clear, naturally double-terminated quartz crystals, with a point at each end and faceted sides. They formed in pockets of dolostone around Herkimer County, New York, around 500 million years ago, and are famous for their brilliance and flawless faces. Many pieces are small enough to fit on a fingertip, though some are large collector specimens. They are typically so clear that they appear almost cut by hand, and they sparkle like glass in the sunlight. Dealers also sell similar double-terminated quartz from other localities under the Herkimer name, which can be confusing.
history: Herkimer diamonds were first noticed by early Mohawk Valley settlers in the 1700s, who picked them from rocky outcrops and farm fields. Native Americans in the region may have used them before that, although records are sparse. Visitors flock to mines in Herkimer County, New York, where they can dig their own stones. The Herkimer name was applied to them in the 19th century, and the diamond nickname arose from their brilliant clarity. They became fashionable in jewelry, and mineral collectors prize them for natural double termination, which is unusual in quartz.
meaning: Herkimer diamonds are among the most energetically intense quartz in crystal tradition. Practitioners say the double termination lets energy flow in and out at both ends, which makes the stone a strong amplifier and a good attunement tool. It is used for meditation, dream work and intuitive practice, and many say it helps release stress and clear emotional clutter. Linked to the crown and third eye chakras, it is also placed on the heart for balanced openness. Some people pair it with other stones to increase their effects, or sleep with one to encourage vivid dream recall. Because it is lively, it can feel stimulating, so some prefer to use it during the day. Physical associations are gentle: relaxation and relief from tension.
howToUse: Hold a Herkimer in each hand during meditation to feel energy pass through the crystal. Place one on your forehead while lying down and breathe slowly. Wear it as a pendant or ring to keep its sparkle and energy near. Put one on your altar with other stones to amplify them. Place a small piece beside your pillow for dream work, though if it feels too stimulating, move it to a shelf. Add Herkimers to a grid at the corners to project a clear, bright intention. Carry one to a busy event for a sense of poise.
care: Herkimer diamonds are quartz and handle water, sunlight and sound well. Rinse in cool water and dry with a soft cloth to keep them sparkling. Cleanse by moonlight, smoke, sound or on a selenite plate. Avoid sudden temperature changes and ultrasonic cleaners, which can worsen internal fractures. Store each stone separately, because the sharp terminations can scratch softer gems. For jewelry, avoid knocks that could chip the points, and check settings regularly.
identify: Genuine Herkimers are double-terminated, with six sides and a point at each end, and are usually very clear with a bright, glassy luster. Small inclusions of carbon, water bubbles and tiny fractures are common and are signs of authenticity. Fakes include faceted glass and cut quartz sold as Herkimer. Double-terminated quartz from other places is similar in look but not from Herkimer County. A true Herkimer is lively under light, and real quartz will scratch glass.

faq.q: Is a Herkimer diamond a real diamond?
faq.a: No. It is a type of clear quartz with natural double terminations. The name comes from its brilliance and its origin in Herkimer County, New York. It is far softer than a true diamond, at Mohs hardness 7.

faq.q: What is a Herkimer diamond good for?
faq.a: In crystal tradition Herkimers are used to amplify energy, support meditation and encourage vivid dreams. Practitioners say the double termination lets energy move in both directions.

faq.q: Can Herkimer diamonds go in water?
faq.a: Yes. Quartz is stable, so they can be rinsed or soaked briefly. Dry them well and avoid sudden temperature changes, especially if the crystal has internal fractures.
